text: includes Erythropoietin Concentrated Solution. Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Erythropoietin Concentrated Solution). A clear or slightly turbid colourless solution, containing 0.05 to 1% of glyc- oproteins indistinguishable from naturally occurring human erythropoietin in terms of amino acid sequence and glycosyla- tion pattern. It has a potency of not less than 100 000 units per mg of active substance. Store in airtight containers below −20° and avoid repeated freezing and thawing.
